responsibility: Contains the main handwritten implementation of the TILE-Gx GCC backend and target hooks. It owns ABI and calling-convention decisions, mode support, option override logic, address legitimacy and PIC handling, prologue/epilogue and varargs expansion, constant/move/multiply lowering, builtin initialization and expansion, scheduling and bundling hooks, assembly emission helpers, profiling, trampoline/thunk support, and final TARGET_INITIALIZER hook wiring that connects the port to GCC’s middle end and RTL back end.
same_name_distinction: Implements the TILE-Gx backend’s executable C logic and target hook bodies, whereas tilegx.h supplies compile-time target macros/data definitions, tilegx.md supplies declarative RTL instruction patterns and expanders, and tilegx.opt declares the target command-line options consumed by code such as tilegx_option_override.
